original_test_intent: Induce one approved fan or power fault and visually verify the mapped front error indicator, then restore safely.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Apply bounded deliberate fault, observe indicator, collect correlated evidence and recover.

historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED to MANUAL ONLY; rejected adding press/clear behavior.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Qualified operator controls physical fault and visual observation; agent may collect telemetry/logs.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: One deliberate fan-or-power fault and direct indicator observation.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Exact target/method/dwell, expected state/timeout, redundancy and recovery.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: A pre-existing fault does not automatically satisfy deliberate-stimulus coverage.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Synchronize operator video with approved read-only SEL/sensor collection.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform fault-indicator table and service SOP.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Thermal/power redundancy loss may affect hardware or service.

safety_boundaries: No guessed fault or exceeded dwell
Stop on unexpected impact/loss of redundancy
no_automatic_retry: No second fault after abnormal response without approval.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already makes the manual core and deliberate-stimulus boundary explicit.
